# Ampt Over Electric

> > Calgary's A+ BBB-rated electrical contractor since 2009, providing Red Seal certified residential, commercial, and industrial electrical services with 24/7 emergency support.

Ampt Over Electric is a licensed and insured Calgary electrical company led by Alberta Master Electricians and Journeymen, specializing in panel upgrades, EV charger installation, and code-compliant electrical work. The team has built a reputation for quality service with numerous customer testimonials from clients like Jenn Cammell, Donna Clarke, and Tanya L.
